items.title: Dick Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: ‘tune in tonight and hear Jack Benny and Phil Harris and all that.’

ctx.x: Yeah. What did you do in the service?

I was a radio operator. I was fortunate to have, they called them Classification Specialists, who would interview you, as you are interviewing me, and determine how I would best serve Uncle Sam. It was the time of the Korean War and so you would think that they would exercise a little more wisdom than they did in my case. Well I’ll give you an example.
